confidence_notes: Searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Vang Vieng prices. Beer, coffee and meal figures come from aggregated cost guides and travel blogs, which give about $1-2.50 for a beer, about $1 for coffee, and $3-7 for a dinner. Cappuccino and the mid-range two-person meal are adjusted upward from those ranges. The cocktail and wine searches returned no prices, so those two are inferred from the local beer price (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 2x beer, imported wine). All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Vang Vieng's backpacker and boutique market, not checked against any listings. Prices in Vang Vieng vary by season, and riverside bars cost more than places in town.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Vang Vieng's own guide prices, cross-checked against Luang Prabang and other tourist-oriented Laos and northern Thailand backpacker towns. Prices there are slightly above the Laos average because of the tourism concentration.
